title: DNA Extraction and mtDNA Genome Sequencing
author: M. Alejandra Camacho
materials: For the library preparation we use the QIAseq FX DNA Library Kit (Qiagen) The handbook of FX DNA Library Kit. HB-2015-006_HB_QIAseq_FX_DNA_Library_0624_WW.pdf
For this version of extraction the DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit (Qiagen) is used.

steps.title: Prepare tissue sample
steps.instruction: Manually chop the tissue, soak in water at room temperature for 6 h, then discard the water.

steps.title: Alkaline lysis
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL alkaline lysis buffer (0.1 M NaOH, 1 % SDS) to each 1.5 mL screw‑cap Eppendorf tube containing the tissue.

steps.title: Wash tissue pieces
steps.instruction: Wash the tissue pieces three times with 400 µL nuclease‑free water, incubating 30 min each wash.

steps.title: Cool on ice
steps.instruction: Place the tubes on ice for 2 min.

steps.title: Heat lysis with ATL
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL ATL buffer pre‑warmed to 98 °C, then incubate at 98 °C for 15 min in a heating block.

steps.title: Optional extra Proteinase K
steps.instruction: If tissue is not fully digested, add Proteinase K up to three times in 25 µL increments.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Add 40 µL Proteinase K and incubate for 48 h at 65 °C.

steps.title: Measure DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with a Qubit fluorometer using the 1× ds High Sensitivity kit.

steps.title: Vortex and spin
steps.instruction: Vortex the sample for 15 s and briefly spin down.

steps.title: Add AL buffer
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL AL buffer (for both aliquots), vortex, then centrifuge.

steps.title: Split sample for column
steps.instruction: Split the lysate into two tubes; both will be loaded onto the same spin column.

steps.title: Load onto spin column
steps.instruction: Load both aliquots onto the same column and spin at 8 000 rpm for 1 min.

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL ethanol (96–100 %), vortex thoroughly and centrifuge.

steps.title: Transfer column
steps.instruction: Discard the collection tube and place the column in a new collection tube.

steps.title: AW1 wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL AW1 buffer and spin at 8 000 rpm for 1 min.

steps.title: Add AE elution buffer
steps.instruction: Place the column in a new 1.5 mL tube and add 140 µL AE buffer to the column.

steps.title: Spin empty column
steps.instruction: Spin the empty column at 14 000 rpm for 1 min.

steps.title: AW2 wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL AW2 buffer and spin at 14 000 rpm for 3 min.

steps.title: Final incubation and spin
steps.instruction: Incubate the column at room temperature for 30 min, then spin at 8 000 rpm for 1 min.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL phenol/chloroform/isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1), mix gently for 5 min.

steps.title: Cool after PCIA
steps.instruction: Cool the mixture at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: High‑temperature incubation
steps.instruction: Add the tissue piece and incubate at 100 °C for 40 min.

steps.title: Mix and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Mix gently for 5 min, then centrifuge at 10 000 rpm for 5 min.

steps.title: Chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a fresh tube, add 500 µL chloroform, mix, then centrifuge at 10 000 rpm for 5 min.

steps.title: High‑speed centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 000 g for 30 min at room temperature and carefully remove the supernatant.

steps.title: DNA precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a new tube and precipitate DNA by adding 0.6–1 × volume isopropanol and 0.1 × volume 3 M sodium acetate.

steps.title: Dry pellet
steps.instruction: Remove all ethanol, then dry the pellet with the tube open for 5 min.

steps.title: Ethanol wash of pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 500–1000 µL 85 % ethanol and centrifuge at 13 000 g for 5 min.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried pellet in 50 µL nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Check buffer pH
steps.instruction: If the solution is not yellow (pH 7.5), add 10 µL 3 M sodium acetate.

steps.title: Add ERC buffer (optional)
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL ERC buffer to each 100 µL lysate portion.

steps.title: Alternative ATL/Proteinase K incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate tissue with 180 µL ATL lysis buffer (Qiagen) and 20 µL Proteinase K at 55 °C for 48 h in a heat block.

steps.title: Transfer to MinElute column
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample to a MinElute spin column.

steps.title: Spin and reuse column
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10 000 g for 1 min, discard the collection tube, and reuse the column with a new sample portion if needed.

steps.title: PE buffer wash
steps.instruction: Wash bound DNA with 750 µL PE buffer and centrifuge at 10 000 g for 1 min.

steps.title: Final elution
steps.instruction: Place the column in a new 1.5 mL tube, add 50 µL EB buffer, incubate 1 min at room temperature, then centrifuge at 10 000 g for 1 min.

steps.title: Prepare Qubit assay
steps.instruction: Aliquot 199 µL 1× working solution into each Qubit assay tube (one per sample) and prepare two extra tubes with 190 µL working solution for standards.

steps.title: Add sample and standards
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL DNA sample to each assay tube and 10 µL of each standard (Standard 1, Standard 2); final volume in each tube is 200 µL.

steps.title: Calibrate and measure Qubit
steps.instruction: Calibrate the Qubit fluorometer with the standards per the manufacturer’s instructions, vortex each tube vigorously, pulse‑centrifuge, incubate 2 min at room temperature, then read the fluorescence.

steps.title: Fragmentation and end‑prep
steps.instruction: Prepare a 50 µL reaction containing 5 µL 10× FX Buffer, 10 µL FX Enzyme Mix, and 35 µL DNA (100 ng). Incubate 4 °C 1 min, 32 °C 1 min, 65 °C 30 min, then hold at 4 °C. Note: DNA is highly degraded (≤500 bp) and low concentration (≤3 ng/µL).

steps.title: Dilute sample for library
steps.instruction: Dilute the DNA to 100 ng in 35 µL with nuclease‑free water (final concentration 100 ng/35 µL).

steps.title: Library quantification
steps.instruction: Measure library concentration with the Qubit fluorometer (as in Step 4). Optionally assess fragment length on a Bioanalyzer, TapeStation, or 1.5 % agarose gel if concentration is sufficient.

steps.title: Adapter ligation reaction
steps.instruction: Mix 20 µL 5× DNA‑Ligase Buffer, 10 µL DNA‑Ligase, 15 µL nuclease‑free H₂O, 5 µL unique adapter, and 50 µL previous reaction (total 100 µL). Incubate at 20 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: First bead clean‑up
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL Ampure XP beads to the ligation reaction, incubate 5 min at room temperature, then place on a magnetic stand for 2 min and remove supernatant.

steps.title: Bead ethanol washes
steps.instruction: Wash beads twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol for 30 s each, carefully removing supernatant each time.

steps.title: Dry beads
steps.instruction: Allow beads to dry on the magnetic stand for ~5 min until the pellet loses its shine.

steps.title: Elute ligated library
steps.instruction: Add 52.5 µL elution buffer to the dried beads, resuspend, incubate 2 min off the magnetic stand, place back on the stand, incubate additional 2 min, then remove 50 µL supernatant to a new PCR tube.

steps.title: Library amplification PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare a 50 µL PCR mix with 25 µL 2× HiFi PCR Master Mix, 1.5 µL adapter primer mix, and 23.5 µL cleaned‑up DNA. Cycle: 98 °C 2 min (1 x), 98 °C 20 s (8 x), 60 °C 30 s (8 x), 72 °C 30 s (8 x), 72 °C 1 min (1 x), hold 4 °C.

steps.title: Second bead clean‑up
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL Ampure XP beads to the PCR product, incubate 5 min at room temperature, place on magnetic stand for 2 min, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Bead washes after PCR
steps.instruction: Wash beads twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol for 30 s each, then dry on the magnetic stand for ~5 min.

steps.title: Final elution of library
steps.instruction: Add 52.5 µL elution buffer to the dried beads, resuspend, incubate 2 min off the stand, return to the stand for another 2 min, then remove 50 µL supernatant to a new PCR tube.

steps.title: Store library
steps.instruction: Store the eluate at 4 °C for up to one day; for long‑term storage keep at –20 °C.

steps.title: Start sequencing
steps.instruction: Pool libraries according to the flow cell and instrument specifications, then start the Illumina run. Expect mitochondrial DNA to represent <0.5–1 % of reads; aim for ≥10 million reads per sample for complete mtDNA genome recovery.
